remarks: Nestled on a quiet street in Stamford's highly desirable Westover neighborhood, this spacious split-level home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a flexible layout with potential for an in-law suite. A dramatic living room with soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and hardwood floors creates an impressive first impression. The sun-filled eat-in kitchen features granite countertops, a center island, skylights, and a dining area overlooking the private backyard. The primary suite includes a spacious bath with a whirlpool tub, while the lower-level family room provides additional living space with direct access to the outdoors. Enjoy the sunroom, oversized deck, and peaceful tree-lined setting surrounded by mature landscaping. Set on a beautiful lot in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods, this home offers space, privacy, and endless possibilities.
